title: Sheehan as counsel to Disclosure Project, John Mack and Elizondo

tellings.quote: he knew perfectly well that for 20 years I was legal counsel for the disclosure project he knew I represented Dr John Mack he knew that I was at the peer group

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan says that for twenty years he was the legal counsel for the Disclosure Project, a group that gathered witnesses to push the US government to release what it knows about UFOs, and that he also represented the psychiatrist John Mack and attended what he calls "the peer group." Sheehan says this himself on Michels's show, as someone who took part, and he raises it to say that Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official involved in UFO matters, knew perfectly well who Sheehan was and what he had done.
